Proposed diagram changes
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: PersistentLayer
  |   |   `-- Reorganize the storage overview around catalog publication, workspace checkpoint records, and the separate stores for proposals, contexts, chat, workflow runs, and push integration. The existing overview treats workspace checkpoints as whole payloads; retain its accurate catalog and immutable diagram-record relationships. Mark SearchArtifact as proposed and unimplemented.
  |   |-- [2] Add: Canvas checkpoint records and retention
  |   |   `-- Attach to the overview's MappingWorkspaceStore and Workspace autosave components. Show bounded checkpoint deltas, shared immutable values and text, referenced revision retention, and restoration; this needs more detail than the overview.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Checkpoint capture for catalog publication
  |       `-- Attach to Explicit catalog publication. Show the flushed workspace checkpoint being captured before its references are published to the saved catalog, rather than depicting save as publication of an unflushed live snapshot.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |       `-- Keep its owner-to-storage and restore flow, but replace whole-checkpoint payload writes with encoded deltas and shared items, note bounded parallel durable writes, and show explicit flush before checkpoint-dependent publication.
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: MappingPage baseline overview
  |   |   `-- Update its WorkspacePersistence and WorkspaceStorage branches to reference checkpoint/item records and flush; keep rendering and the derived node registry separate from storage. Attach the storage detail to its Workspace persistence flow component.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |       `-- Retain checkpoint ownership, but add retained presentation, review, context, and CanvasView dependencies to checkpoint revision bindings; note that persistence encodes checkpoints without changing the expanded history read model.
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: [P] Session persistence and reopening
  |       `-- Add retained revision and checkpoint dependencies to its existing manifest-and-immutable-record account. Proposal persistence and catalog acceptance remain separate publications.
  `-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
          `-- Add saved context and captured-source persistence, including immutable source snapshots and pinned Git reads. Attach these stores to the diagram's immutable captured-state and serialization branches; context storage does not take over canvas rendering.
